citation_not_found.finding: HY 2954 does not appear anywhere in the real GY 6010 TDS's 17-entry hardener compatibility table; the cited source/product-combination could not be located.

claim_under_attack.claim_text: The envelope gates' fail-closed metrics carry a real sample size drawn from published formulations.

g3_rescore_against_real_external_toleran.disagreement: Every real, named, explicit tolerance band located this fire is asymmetric and diverges from the module's assumed symmetric +/-5% band by a wide margin on at least one side (ranges from -6.3%/+9.5% to -10.3%/+19.5%). Zero of 4 real sources match the module's G3 assumption. G3, as currently written, would REJECT (is_5pct=False) every one of these 4 real, named, published tolerance bands if they were substituted for the fixture's self-authored numbers.
g3_rescore_against_real_external_toleran.method: The module's own oracle (benchmarks/constraint-envelope-oracle-v1/run_envelope_gates.py, function run(), gate G3) asserts every envelope's tolerance band is a symmetric +/-5%-by-mass-per-part window (TOL_FRAC=0.05, checked via is_5pct). This re-score applies that identical G3 arithmetic to 4 real, named, explicit tolerance bands found this fire (WEST SYSTEM 105/205, 105/206, 105/207, 105/209) instead of to the fixture's self-authored numbers.

internal_self_consistency_defects.defect: envelope_id declares a 100:30 ratio, but the envelope's own nominal_part_a_g/nominal_part_b_g are 200.0/30.0 (a 200:30, i.e. ~100:15, ratio) -- the id-declared ratio and the recorded nominal masses disagree with each other. This is a defect internal to the self-authored fixture, requiring no external source to establish.
internal_self_consistency_defects.oracle_gap: G4 (nominal_parts_sum_to_total in run_envelope_gates.py) checks only that nominal_part_a_g + nominal_part_b_g == nominal_total_g (200+30==230, TRUE); it never checks that the envelope_id's stated ratio matches the recorded nominal masses, so this defect passes every check the module's own oracle runs.

proposed_followups.defect: 3 of 10 self-authored KAT envelopes (dgeba-teta-primer-9to1, dgeba-deta-industrial-primer-17to1, dgeba-amidoamine-huntsman-100to50) cite named supplier TDSs whose real, located values diverge from the fixture's nominal ratio by 11.4%-87.0%, and 1 envelope (dgeba-ipda-marine-primer-100to24) cites a hardener/resin combination (GY 6010 + HY 2954) absent from the real located TDS.
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: Either (a) re-derive these 4 envelopes' nominal ratios and tolerance bands directly from a verbatim-quoted passage of the real named source with the exact figure highlighted, or (b) replace the citation with a source that can be verified, or (c) mark the envelope provenance UNVERIFIED in the KAT fixture and exclude it from any 'published formulation' population claim until verified.

proposed_followups.defect: dgeba-pacm-marine-topcoat-100to30's envelope_id declares a 100:30 ratio but its nominal_part_a_g/nominal_part_b_g are 200.0/30.0 (a ~100:15 ratio); the module's own oracle G4 check (nominal sum to total) does not catch id/data ratio mismatches.
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: Either correct the envelope's nominal masses to match its declared 100:30 id, or rename the id to match the recorded 200:30 masses, and add an oracle check that the envelope_id's declared ratio is consistent with nominal_part_a_g/nominal_part_b_g within a stated tolerance.

proposed_followups.defect: The module's G3 gate assumes every published epoxy mix-ratio QC tolerance band is symmetric +/-5% by mass per part (Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 Sec.24.3, uncited page/quote). All 4 real, named, explicit tolerance bands located this fire (WEST SYSTEM 105/205, 105/206, 105/207, 105/209) are asymmetric and diverge from +/-5% by up to 4x on one side.
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: Obtain and quote verbatim the actual Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 Sec.24.3 passage the module's tolerance construction is based on (via a library/interlibrary loan or purchased excerpt, since it was not accessible over the open web this fire), and either confirm the +/-5% symmetric figure against that primary text or replace G3's assumption with a tolerance model that accounts for asymmetric, product-specific published bands.

proposed_followups.defect: This fire located only 4 of the 5 required named supplier/formulation-guide sources carrying an explicit two-part epoxy mix-ratio tolerance band (all 4 from one manufacturer family, WEST SYSTEM/Gougeon Brothers); a 5th independent source was not found within budget.
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: Locate >=1 additional named supplier TDS or published formulation guide (independent of Gougeon Brothers) that states an explicit numeric mix-ratio tolerance band, with its license quoted verbatim, and fold it into the G3 re-score above.

sweep_summary.note_on_shortfall: 4 of 5 required explicit-tolerance-band sources found (all from the WEST SYSTEM / Gougeon Brothers product family); a 5th independent supplier or formulation-guide source with an explicit numeric mix-ratio tolerance band was searched for (Jotun, PPG/Amercoat, Sherwin-Williams, International Paint/Intergard, Hempel, System Three, 3M Scotch-Weld, Devcon, MIL-DTL-24441, and the fixture's own primary citation Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 itself) but not located within this fire's time budget -- see proposed_followups.

verdict_basis: The claim under attack asserts the fail-closed metrics' population is drawn from published formulations. This fire swept 12 named, queried sources and found: (1) 3 of the fixture's 10 envelopes (30% of the envelope population, 15 of 50 KAT test cases) cite named supplier products whose real, located technical data sheets state a materially different nominal mix ratio -- deviations of 11.4%-87.0%, all larger than the module's own asserted +/-5% QC tolerance -- such that the chemically-correct, real-world stoichiometric mix for the cited product would be REJECTED (not PASS) by the fixture's own envelope; (2) 1 envelope cites a specific product combination (GY 6010 + HY 2954) that does not appear in the real, located TDS for that resin at all; (3) 1 envelope has an internal defect where the envelope_id's declared ratio (100:30) contradicts its own recorded nominal masses (200g:30g), a defect the module's own G4 self-check does not catch; (4) the module's G3 gate's foundational assumption -- that published epoxy mix-ratio QC tolerance is symmetric +/-5% by mass per part -- disagrees with all 4 real, named, explicit tolerance bands located this fire, none of which are symmetric and none of which are +/-5%. The population underlying this module's fail-closed metrics is not a reliable re-derivation of published formulations; it is a self-authored compilation whose specific numeric citations do not verify against the real documents named.
